_comment.chat: chat.agent.enabled keeps Agent mode in the mode picker — the panel OPENS in Agent mode and our participant handles all three modes. chat.commandCenter.enabled was removed: that key does not exist at 1.109 (the successor is chat.agentsControl.enabled, left at its default).
_comment.sendElementsToChat: The Simple Browser overlay (src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/attachments/simpleBrowserEditorOverlay.ts) tries to attach a browser-elements debug session on every preview open; that can never succeed in this web deployment, so it toasts 'Please reopen the preview.' every time. Default is true; false removes the overlay at the source (the controller returns before wiring anything).
_comment.terminalProfiles: The editor's terminal dropdown IS the agent picker. Every agent CLI is baked into the snapshot, so any of them starts without a re-launch. 'Agent' attaches to the tmux session Oyren's own web terminal shows — same conversation, live, in both places. The named profiles start a SEPARATE agent that shares the files but not the chat, and only the agent this session launched with is guaranteed to have credentials. Every AGENT profile here runs inside tmux (oyren-agent-term), which is what makes closing a terminal tab a DETACH rather than a kill: press Ctrl-b then d to detach by hand, and pick the 'bash' profile from this same dropdown when you want a plain shell with no tmux at all.
_comment.scoping: Cosmetic only. A session is meant to open on its repo and stay there, and the router pins
?folder= to $WORKDIR (see sandbox-runtime/src/ideFolder.js) — but that is UX shaping, NOT a
boundary: /vscode-remote-resource takes an absolute path with no validation, and the integrated
terminal is a shell. The boundary is the per-session VM and the oyren unix user, which is where
SageMaker, Cloud Shell, Gitpod and Coder all put it too. Do not mistake these lines for security.
Note the menu bar can be brought back by right-clicking the activity bar.
_comment.claudeCode: The sandbox already runs claude with everything allowed (sandbox-runtime seeds ~/.claude/settings.json to bypassPermissions + IS_SANDBOX=1), but the Claude Code EXTENSION's mode picker never reads that file — it reads these two settings and otherwise defaults to Manual, telling the user the opposite of the truth. BOTH keys are required: without the boolean the extension silently downgrades bypassPermissions back to Manual. Machine scope on purpose — re-seeded from extras every boot, so the visible default matches the actual policy even though a user can still switch modes per conversation.
_comment.claudeLogin: The Claude Code panel's Sign In runs an OAuth loopback callback on a random remote port — it can never complete from the user's browser (the redirect lands on the USER'S localhost). Credentials are pre-seeded at ~/.claude/.credentials.json, so the prompt is a dead end that looks like a bug. The extension's own setting exists for exactly this (verified in anthropic.claude-code 2.1.222 contributes.configuration).
_comment.claudeProcessWrapper: Routes the extension's claude spawns through wrapper v2 (composer PR #14: contract-faithful relay — exact argv forwarded, framed stdio over the broker socket, any pre-output failure degrades to plain passthrough) so an in-flight turn COMPLETES server-side when the panel is disposed. History: the v1 wrapper was restored here on 2026-08-13 (snapshot 241007658) and broke every Chat panel ('Subprocess initialization did not complete within 60000ms' — v1 spawned claude with an empty argv); v2's passthrough degrade makes that failure class impossible, and its mechanical e2e passed on a prod-snapshot droplet 2026-08-14 (broker handshake, full turn, SIGKILL drain, fallbacks). CAUTION: the extension uses this path as the claude executable with NO existence check (resolveClaudeBinary, v2.1.228), so this setting must only ship while snapshots bake the wrapper binary (they have since the 2416798xx line; OYREN_CLAUDE_WRAPPER=1 in host.env). GATE: merge only after the human drill — close a real Chat tab mid-turn, reopen, turn shows completed not Interrupted.
